name: Democratic Republic of the Congo (1960–1963)
description: A blue field with a large yellow five-pointed star in the centre and six smaller yellow stars in a column along the hoist.
history: Flag of the Republic of the Congo (Léopoldville) at independence from Belgium on 30 June 1960, retaining the blue and gold star of the Congo Free State and adding six small stars for the six provinces of the new republic. It was replaced in 1963 by a flag with a red diagonal band.
